-- web/web.go --
package web

import "net/http"

type Greeter struct{}

//fabrik:provider
func NewGreeter() *Greeter { return &Greeter{} }

type Handlers struct {
	Greeter *Greeter
}

//fabrik:http GET /
func (h *Handlers) Index(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}

// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"

	"app/setup"
	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Wire hooks: config exists, providers do not
		if err := setup.Logging(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := setup.Tracing(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		// Providers
		r := router.New()
		webGreeter := web.NewGreeter()
		webHandlers := &web.Handlers{
			Greeter: webGreeter,
		}

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/", webHandlers.Index)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
